description: Render the full text content of a file annotated with line numbers. Every line of the content is emitted as a 1-based line number right-justified in a four-character field, followed by ' | ', followed by the original line text. Lines are joined by newlines with no trailing newline after the final line.

input.content:
This is a test file
With multiple lines
For testing file operations

cases.expected_output:
1 | This is a test file
   2 | With multiple lines
   3 | For testing file operations
